film.title: Independence Day
film.moment: An original interpretation of an enormous ship charging a beam over a city.

sources.observation: The existing scene presents a mothership, energy beam and collapsing skyline.

intent: Make the quiet skyline and visible charging core establish scale before the city-wide shockwave.
signature: Wide disk-shaped ship silhouetted above a readable skyline
Green-white charging core as the focal point against a muted cool sky
Warm expanding shock front with clear foreground/background separation

beats.label: ARRIVAL
beats.action: Hold the ship above the readable skyline while its core slowly brightens.

beats.label: CONTACT
beats.action: Bring up the beam, flash at 13 seconds, then spread the shockwave and begin collapse.

beats.label: AFTERMATH
beats.action: Fade the beam and debris while retaining the broken skyline silhouette.

quality.lite: Keep the ship silhouette, beam and collapse with minimal debris.
quality.balanced: Retain the event timing with reduced particles and phone geometry below 150000 triangles.
quality.high: Use existing authored city detail and finishing effects.
quality.ultra: Keep the same timing and use existing dense-display quality support.

audio.direction: Retain the existing original bed and synchronized charge/blast cues.

cues.description: Blast transient aligned to the visual flash.

acceptance: Charging core is visible before the beam
The skyline remains readable at BALANCED
Normal-speed playback builds anticipation, delivers a brief flash and reveals the collapse without prolonged glare
Title and phase text stay legible against the moving scene; pause, scrub and replay give immediate feedback
A paused 16 → 27 → 16 seek restores exact pixels
assumptions: This is an example brief derived from this site's interpretation, not shot-by-shot film research or an implemented refinement.
Ship scale, fill lighting and shockwave timing may be stylized to improve cinematic composition and readability.
